text:
emma: Quick heads-up before Friday KPI review 1. Launch socials drove a nice spike but our dashboard totals don't line up with CRM. GA last-click shows 410 campaign-attributed leads; CRM shows 600 leads but 240 have campaign=null. Need to reconcile for the slide notes.

rory: Hmm. Any intermediate shortlinks or JS redirects in the flow? those often strip UTMs on some clients.

zara: We used short.lnk -> tracker -> landing (two hops). I suspect some iOS webviews and email clients drop the params on the 302. Also webinar signups via Typeform webhooks sometimes omit query params.

max: Quick SQL to spitball counts: ```SELECT coalesce(utm_campaign,'(null)') AS camp, count(*) FROM crm.leads WHERE created_at > '2026-03-08' GROUP BY 1;``` returned ~240 nulls, majority user_agent LIKE '%WebView%'.

emma: OK. Ops, can you run a backfill to set campaign='launch_spring' when referrer path contains '/spring-launch' and campaign is null? We need numbers in time for the deck. @opsbot

opsbot: opsbot: Rehydration job enqueued by @ops. Job id: job_backfill_881. Estimated run time 1.5h. Will set campaign='launch_spring' where campaign IS NULL AND referrer ILIKE '%/spring-launch%'.

rory: For the KPI slide, request we show two columns: 1) GA (client-side last-click) 2) CRM (post-backfill). Also add a tiny footnote: "inconsistencies due to shortlink 302 behavior + Typeform webhook omissions; backfill applied on MM/DD."

zara: Can we also add a "webview" filter in the dashboard so PMs can toggle the cohort? That would make the conversion delta obvious.

max: I'll add a filter tile once ops reports back that the job completed. Meanwhile I'll prepare a two-row table for the slide: totals by attribution model.

emma: If ops finishes before the prep call we'll update live. If not, show pre-backfill numbers with the footnote and mark "under investigation".

opsbot: opsbot: job_backfill_881 status: queued.

emma: Thanks team. Short and sweet: ops runs backfill, Max prepares slide with both columns + footnote, Zara adds webview filter if job finishes. We'll finalize during the KPI sync at 10:30.

rory: Also opened a small engineering ticket to drop a 7d persistent cookie on first touch so future shortlink hops don't lose first-touch params. Ticket ENG-4521.

emma: Perfect. See you at the sync.
